title: Not Microsoft. Not Google. Analysts Call This $2.7 Trillion Tech Titan the Most Undervalued AI Play.
author: Brett Schafer
description: Amazon is positioned as an undervalued AI play despite its $2.7 trillion market cap. AWS revenue grew 37% year-over-year to $42.2 billion, driven by AI infrastructure demand. The company is also integrating AI across its retail business through search tools, ad targeting, and supply chain automation. With projected earnings of $161 billion and a forward P/E of 17, analysts believe Amazon stock has significant upside potential.

title: Should Invesco S&P 100 Equal Weight ETF (EQWL) Be on Your Investing Radar?
author: Zacks.Com
description: The Invesco S&P 100 Equal Weight ETF (EQWL) is a passively managed large-cap blend ETF with $2.78 billion in assets and a competitive 0.25% expense ratio. With 103 holdings and a beta of 0.89, it offers medium-risk diversification. Year-to-date performance is 11.37% and one-year performance is 14.45%. The ETF received a Zacks ETF Rank of 3 (Hold), positioning it as a sufficient option for large-cap blend exposure, though lower-cost alternatives like VOO and IVV are also available.

title: Nvidia, Palantir, and Alphabet Are Sending Shockwaves Through Wall Street With This $17.5 Billion Warning
author: Sean Williams
description: Insiders at three major AI powerhouses—Nvidia, Palantir, and Alphabet—have sold approximately $17.5 billion more stock than they've purchased over the past five years, raising concerns about valuation and a potential AI bubble. While insider stock sales can be attributed to tax obligations, the minimal insider buying activity suggests limited confidence in near-term share price appreciation.

title: The Overlooked AI Stock Poised to Outperform Nvidia and Palantir
author: Marc Guberti
description: Vertiv, a liquid cooling specialist, is positioned as a critical AI infrastructure play that may outperform Nvidia and Palantir. As AI chips generate excessive heat that air cooling cannot manage, Vertiv's liquid cooling systems have become essential for data centers. The company reported 24% YoY revenue growth in Q2 with management guidance for 31% full-year growth, while trading at a relatively attractive 1-year forward P/E of 28 and a PEG ratio of 0.84.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong revenue growth (24% YoY, 31% guidance), 44% operating profit increase, strategic Nvidia partnership, expanding market presence, attractive valuation metrics (P/E 28, PEG 0.84), and positioned as clear market leader in AI liquid cooling with long-term growth catalysts.

Mentioned as established leader in AI chips but article suggests Vertiv may outperform it going forward. Nvidia is presented as a complementary business rather than a direct competitor, with Vertiv's success dependent on Nvidia's continued growth.

title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Palantir Technologies, BP and Quanta
